item.title: Ask HN: Which developer tool got worse as it became popular?
item.summary: What tool do you think was better before it became widely used? What changed? More features, more complexity, worse defaults, enterprise stuff, etc. And did you switch to something else, or just keep using it? Interested in specific examples rather than “everything was better before.” Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49387714 Points: 2 # Comments: 8
